canvas.$description: 24pt icon canvas — bounding box for all icons. Icons render at 1× vector.

liveArea.$description: 20pt live area (2pt padding all sides within 24pt canvas). Glyph artwork must fit within this area.

padding.$description: 2pt padding all sides between canvas edge and live area

xs.$description: 16pt icon size — small inline icons, metadata

sm.$description: 20pt icon size — secondary navigation, list row icons

md.$description: 24pt icon size — default (matches canvas). Tab bar, buttons, standard UI icons.

lg.$description: 32pt icon size — feature callouts, empty states, large icon moments
